final_goal: Reusable, provider-neutral story visual asset system that searches/reuses/derives/composites accepted assets before generating new images.

current_gate.next: Run G1A early-discrimination benchmark: 5 tasks × 3 style profiles under controlled provider/model/settings, then Reviewer evaluates survivors before G1B.

cost_truth.documented: No verified evidence that semantic art style alone lowers billed image-output tokens at fixed model/quality/size.
cost_truth.strategy: Reduce new generations/retries; exploit lower quality/resolution where acceptable; reuse/derive/composite first.

unknowns: Which of the three style candidates best clears the quality floor with the lowest retry/call burden.
Actual provider-specific billed usage/cost delta under controlled settings.
How well each style survives derive/edit while preserving character and environment continuity.
Minimum reusable asset set needed before reuse rate materially lowers new-generation demand.
Whether structured metadata remains sufficient after the library grows.
